thread:
aisha: quick heads-up — schema-gate dispatch healthcheck spiking in eu-west, lots of fncall responses getting rejected with 'unexpected_array' and falling back to degen route. latency bump but no outage yet.

sam: thanks — any sample payloads or validator logs we can look at?

aisha: pasted one sample below:
```json
{
  "tool": "search",
  "result": ["doc1", "doc2"]
}
```
validator error: "expected object but got array at /result" (validator v2.3.1)

mike: we rolled validator v2.3.1 to canary yesterday. @lina did the canary include strict toggles?

lina: yes — canary had strict=true for the schema gate, 2% traffic in eu-west only, scheduled full roll tomorrow.

sam: that matches. what's the reject delta and which routes are worst?

aisha: overall rejects from ~0.1% -> ~0.3%, but chat-toolchain route is at ~1.2% (small percent but high volume). retries + degen fallback are increasing cost.

deploy-bot: ALERT: schema-gate-validate v2.3.1 deployed to canary at 2026-03-22T10:01Z — metric: fncall.reject_count +43% in eu-west/queue-3

mike: suggestion: toggle permissive=true to convert hard rejects into soft logs while we triage. avoids backpressure and cost.

lina: I can flip permissive now, but note billing/telemetry semantics will change (we'll log instead of blocking). ok to proceed?

sam: do the toggle. also capture a bunch of trace ids and sample payloads for the time window so we can backfill repros.

aisha: permissive=true applied to canary. rejecting -> logging only. watching metrics now.

mike: please add short-term telemetry augment: tag rejects with route_id, model_variant, and consumer_app; ship sample payloads to S3 for the triage team.

sam: also file a console UX ticket to surface 'schema-gate mode' per route in the global overview — operators keep asking why specific routes fall to degen/fallback.

lina: filing ticket ENG-PLAT-1234 with notes + links to metric panels and sample traces.

aisha: thanks all — will follow up once rates stabilize and we have sample repros. :thumbsup:
